summary.one_liner: A VS Code extension and standalone terminal dashboard (npm package sidekick-agent-hub, binary `sidekick`) that adds real-time visibility, quota tracking, session search and account switching for Claude Max, Claude API, OpenCode and Codex CLI agent sessions.
summary.what_it_does: Sidekick reads session logs from Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode and shows token totals, cost, context usage and quota windows in a VS Code extension and a full-screen terminal dashboard with panels for sessions, tasks, notes, decisions, plans, events and charts. The CLI offers one-shot commands such as daily/weekly/monthly usage, five-hour billing blocks, cross-session search, prompt history dumps, session asset extraction (URLs, paths, commands, plans), and a 13-week quota-utilization heatmap. Account commands register existing Claude Code and Codex logins and switch between them with verification and undo. The README also describes an MCP server with read-only facts for agents, and a shared npm library, sidekick-shared, for building custom tools. The VS Code extension additionally offers inline completions, code transforms and AI commit messages, according to the listing metadata.
use_cases: monitor token usage and quota of a Claude Max or Codex session
switch between multiple Claude or Codex accounts
extract URLs, file paths and commands from recent AI chats
see daily or monthly AI coding costs from session logs
add a one-line agent status footer to the terminal
build custom tooling on top of agent session data
notable: Quota-history heatmap: 13-week, per-workspace view of session-limit utilization
Account switching for Claude Code and Codex logins with verified two-phase switch and undo
Session asset extraction of URLs, files, commands and plans from recent chats
Read-only MCP server so a running agent can inspect quota and context pressure
Sibling shared library sidekick-shared published to npm for building your own tools
caveats: OpenCode database-backed session monitoring needs an executable sqlite3 in the host environment
Account switches reach new claude sessions and the Claude Code extension only after a window reload; the Claude Desktop app is not reached
A Codex account switch waits until all running Codex CLI, app and IDE sessions are closed, and --force does not override this
z.ai Coding Plan is monitored only and not a selectable inference provider, per the README
